answer: Re-attestations are stored in lotus and saffron lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the river graph. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 5 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 2994 identities would post 3912 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
